title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 3957 2nd Avenue in Laurel Hill, Florida, as the "Sergeant First Class William 'Kelly' Lacey Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 3957 2nd Avenue in Laurel Hill, Florida, as the "Sergeant First Class William 'Kelly' Lacey Post Office."

summary.headline: A law that names the Postal Service building at 3957 2nd Avenue in Laurel Hill, Florida, after Sergeant First Class William "Kelly" Lacey.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility in Laurel Hill, Florida, to honor Sergeant First Class William "Kelly" Lacey. It changes only the name of the building and does not change how the post office operates. Mail service, postal rules, and employee duties stay the same.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on July 29, 2016.
